text: Maxwell predicted electromagnetic waves theoretically, and this prediction was confirmed experimentally by Heinrich Hertz about twenty-three years later.
explanation: True: Maxwell's 1865 identification of light as an EM wave was a theoretical prediction (that 1/√(μ₀ε₀) equals the measured speed of light), later confirmed by Hertz's generation and detection of radio waves. It was not an empirical discovery made first in the lab.
